answer: The protocol admits only 40 new identities per epoch through a sealed-bid burn auction: bids are committed, then revealed, and the top 40 each pay the 40th price, burned on-chain and never refunded. A farm trying to forge n aliases must win n of that fixed supply, so every extra alias displaces an honest bidder and lifts the clearing price it pays. Lapsed keys cannot wander off and re-enter cheaply; they bid again. Like rare pigment, admission is rationed by the protocol, not by any outside registry.
